description.plain:
Featuring dual-channel 2.4GHz radios, the RP4TD excels in signal sensitivity, signal-to-noise ratio, and overall performance due to its optimized circuit design. The reliable DCDC power supply circuit ensures lower operating temperatures during extended usage. Additionally, the dual TCXO contributes to the utmost frequency stability and makes the RP4TD a leader in its class. The RP4TD features built in WIFI, allowing you to wirelessly upgrade firmware to configure the receiver via the built-in WebUI with your PC or mobile phone.

Suitable for drones and fixed-wing models, the receiver can be installed in virtually any application that requires a serial receiver!

Check out the rest of our RC receivers and all our RC transmitters, modules, and accessories!

Features

Dual TCXO (temperature compensated crystal oscillator)

The TCXO ensures high stability and accuracy in frequency control, compensating for temperature variations. This results in consistent and reliable signal reception, even in extreme temperature conditions. It also reduces frequency drift over time, providing long-term frequency stability and preventing signal degradation. In our testing, we found that two TCXOs offer better advantages in true diversity receivers.

Specifications

  • Item: RP4TD ExpressLRS 2.4GHz Diversity Receiver
  • Type: ISM
  • MCU: ESP32
  • RF Chip: SX1281 x 2
  • Antenna: 65mm 2.4GHz T Antenna x 2
  • Frequency Range: 2.4GHz
  • Maximum Refresh Rate: 500Hz / F1000Hz
  • Telemetry RF Power: Max 2x 100mW
  • Working Voltage: DC 4.5-12.0V
  • Weight: 1.4g (without antenna)
  • Dimension: 23.7x16.3x4.0mm
  • Firmware Version: ExpressLRS V3.3.0 pre-installed
  • FW Target: RadioMaster RP4TD 2400 RX
  • Bus interface: CRSF
  • Extend interface: UART

Includes

  • 1x RadioMaster RP4TD ExpressLRS 2.4GHz Nano Receiver
  • 1x CRSF wire
  • 3x Heat-Shrinkable Tube
  • 2x 65mm 2.4GHz T Antenna (Installed on receiver)
  • 1x User Manual

Introducing the RadioMaster ER5C-i receiver, built on the cutting-edge ExpressLRS system for outstanding performance. Experience unparalleled reliability, remarkable flexibility in configuration, lightning-fast response times, and an extended receiving range that redefines your usage expectations.

The ER5C-i ELRS receiver empowers your setup by controlling up to 5 servos and includes integrated receiver voltage telemetry and battery telemetry. Its intelligent design automatically detects the appropriate voltage input, streamlining your experience. With a built-in high-sensitivity ceramic antenna, the ER5C-i ensures a seamless installation for all surface models, eliminating concerns about antenna wires. Upgrade to a new level of precision and convenience with the RadioMaster ER5C-i.

description.plain:
RadioMaster XR2 Nano 2.4GHz ExpressLRS Receiver

The XR2 Receiver is a nano-sized powerhouse engineered for 2.4GHz ExpressLRS, featuring an integrated tower antenna that delivers exceptional reception within its ultra-compact design. With a footprint of just 16x12mm and a lightweight of only 0.8g, it fits seamlessly into even the most space-constrained builds. Driven by the advanced Semtech LR1121 transceiver (third generation), the XR2 offers compatibility with all ELRS 2.4GHz transmitters and unlocks the benefits of DK500Hz mode for LR1121-based systems, ensuring unparalleled reliability and responsiveness. The built-in Wi-Fi module simplifies firmware updates and configuration via a WebUI on your PC or mobile device. With ultra-low latency and high refresh rates, the XR2 stands out in Whoops, micro drones, and fixed-wing models, where every gram and millimeter counts for peak performance.

For more details and support, visit expresslrs.org.

Features

  • Integrated 2.4GHz tower antenna
  • ExpressLRS 2.4GHz
  • ESP32C3 high-performance MCU
  • Semtech LR1121 Transceiver
  • Secondary UART port for advanced functionality
  • Castled pads for easy soldering

The Nano receivers, developed by Jye Smith of ExpressLRS, have ESP8285 MCU and SX1280 RF chip. RP1 has a UFL antenna socket while RP2 has a built-in ceramic antenna, making it super light and small. Both have WIFI built in, allowing you to upgrade firmware and configure the Receiver via WebUI. Both RP1 and RP2 have low-latency, high-refresh-rate RF module, making them ideal for FPV and long-range. Furthermore, their ultra-light Nano size allows you to fit them anywhere, from whoops to fixed-wing models. The EP1 comes with ELRS Firmware V3 pre-installed and a TCXO oscillator for solid connection & reliability.

Check out the RP2 if that fits your needs more!

  • Solder pads are improved and easier to solder to.

description.plain:
The RadioMaster ER series of PWM receivers are based on the revolutionary ExpressLRS system. It offers high performance, high reliability, flexible configuration, fast response speed and ultra-long range bringing you brand new experience with your hobby.

The ER6 ELRS receiver has been specially designed for fixed-wing users. It can drive up to 6 servos and has built-in receiver voltage telemetry and flight battery telemetry with the ability to automatically detect which voltage input to use. A 4-wire CRSF interface is provided to facilitate later expansion of telemetry sensors. The ER6 features a dual-antenna with telemetry power up to 100mw. The receiver shell adopts one-piece molding process with high structural strength.

description.plain:
The RadioMaster RP series of receivers are designed with size, ease of use, and range in mind. Utilizing ExpressLRS 2.4GHz open-source firmware the RP series of nano receivers delivers the features and range today’s pilots have come to expect.

Developed around the ESP8285 MCU and SX1280IMLTRT RF Chip the RP series offer Lora and FLRC 2.4GHz RF links offering incredible range and low latency. With WiFi built-in, firmware updates can be done on your aircraft without the need to remove the receiver. Binding can be done using a bind phrase meaning no more bind plugs or fiddly button presses while trying to plug in your battery.

The RP3 receiver features a Skyworks SE2431L providing an LNA for improved receiver performance, a PA providing up to 100mw of telemetry performance, and antenna switching for antenna diversity.

description.plain:
BETAFPV Nano receiver is based on the ExpressLRS project, an open-source RC link for RC applications. ExpressLRS aims to achieve the best possible link performance in both speeds, latency, and range. This makes ExpressLRS one of the fastest RC links available while still offering long-range performance.

Check out all our receivers, and our entire BetaFPV selection!

    Specifications

    • Input voltage: 5V
    • Telemetry power: 20dbm (100mW, 2.4G Version)
    • Frequency bands (Nano receiver 2.4G version): 2.4GHz ISM
    • Frequency bands (Nano receiver 915MHz/868MHz version): 915MHz FCC/868MHz EU
    • Antenna Connector: IPEX MHF (IPEX 1 / U.FL)
    • Size: 12x19mm
    • Weight: 0.7g (receiver only)

    Note: The firmware version of the Nano receiver and module manufactured by our company is ELRS 1.0.0-RC5 (the fifth test version before release);
    ELRS Innovative team has officially released version 1.0.0. Based on the version, we have some updates:

    • 2.4G Nano TX Module supports 500Hz refresh rate；
    • Short press the button on the Nano module 3 times to get into the binding status.

    We suggest our customers upgrade their modules and receivers' ELRS version to 1.0.0. Significantly, the module and receiver have to be in the same ELRS version, otherwise, the frequency cannot match successfully.

    Includes

    • 1x Beta FPV ELRS Nano 2.4GHz Receiver 
    • 1x BetaFPV T Antenna
    • 2x Spare Shrink Tube
    • 4x 30awg Silicon Connection Wires (1 black, 1 red, 1 white, 1 yellow)
    • 1x Pin Header 1x4
